hypothesis: The full-range-to-Manny constraint remapping is a causal active-standing distortion; bypassing only MapProtoPolicyTargetToMannyConstraintRange while retaining AdaptParentRelativeTarget safety projection will strictly improve the locked standing verdict.
supporting_runtime_evidence: E3 localized the dominant first-active-standing target transformation to the range mapper: 14 controls changed, the eight lower-body controls changed by 27.156594 degrees on average, and foot_l changed by 47.093262 degrees.
The physical plant has already demonstrated that it can stand under controlled targets with the same fully simulated topology.
E12 explained the Mode-A/Mode-B launch confound that invalidated E4 and showed all startup modes converge to byte-identical active-standing input and downstream baseline behavior.
competing_explanations: The range mapper is required to translate ProtoMotions full-range targets into Manny's authored constraint ranges; bypassing it will increase safety projection and worsen behavior.
The range mapper is not the causal defect because the policy actions, neutral reference, constraint frames, or another action-decoding stage are already semantically wrong before range adaptation.

single_changed_variable.name: active_standing_constraint_range_remap
held_constant: first-policy and first-active-standing observations and model actions

expected_if_hypothesis_correct: Both variants satisfy exact pre-intervention equivalence; the experimental trace shows no material range-mapping delta while safety projection, publication, and readback remain valid; the locked failed-criteria set strictly shrinks without any new failed criterion.
falsification_observation: Both variants satisfy exact pre-intervention equivalence and the trace verifies the range mapper was bypassed, but the locked failure set is unchanged or worse, a new criterion fails, or safety projection absorbs the unremapped targets without a verdict improvement.
invalid_run_conditions: Either first-policy input is not exact Mode A.
The two first-policy snapshots are not byte-identical or any float32 section differs.
The two first-active-standing policy-input snapshots are not byte-identical before target adaptation.
The configured bypass is not evidenced by an approximately zero range-mapping delta while the baseline has a material nonzero delta.
The action semantic trace is incomplete or invalid, safety projection is not retained, target publication/readback is incomplete, or a raw artifact is malformed or missing.
Source commit, binary, model, protocol, timestep, seed, initial pose, perturbation, capture window, diagnostics, or evaluator differs between arms.

exact_pre_intervention_metrics: first-policy self-observation, mimic-target, terrain, and action float32 section SHA-256
intervention_metrics: mean and maximum constraint safety-projection delta
per-bone lower-body range-mapping and projection deltas
target write/readback counts and maximum readback error
behavioral_metrics: maximum root and body linear and angular speeds
locked_judges.success_rule: The failed-criteria set strictly shrinks without a new failure; thresholds and evaluator remain unchanged.
locked_judges.failure_rule: With a valid run and exact pre-intervention equivalence, the failed-criteria set is unchanged, expands, or gains any new failure.

implementation_constraints: Reuse the existing default-off E4 development-only flag; do not change production code or defaults merely to run E13.
Do not change the activation contract, serialization, permanent readback requirements, protocol, thresholds, physics, dispatch, or action trace schema.
Run a fresh unchanged baseline adjacent to the experiment on one clean commit and reused binary.
Record the exact raw artifacts and verdict before deleting or separately promoting experimental behavior.
